summary: Implementation plan to merge GVONE Studio IDE and Browser into a unified Xcode-style application window. Features a top Development Bar, a bottom-left Navigator Panel integrating Files, Tabs, Chats, Grok Bots, and Extensions (replacing the old Activity Bar), a central multi-mode workspace for web browsing and code editing, an Xcode-style bottom Terminal/Debug console, and a bottom-right Inspector panel.
